metrics.profile_summary: Marketing professional with an MBA and experience in digital strategy and content creation. Proficient in social media management, Canva design, and SEO, with additional experience in HR operations.

education.degree: Master of Business Administration (Marketing and Supply Chain)
Bachelors of Arts in Business Studies

experience.description: Manages social media scheduling, content creation via Canva Pro, PPC reporting, email marketing, and maintains the consumer content calendar.
Coordinated employee engagement and employer branding, utilizing Canva for job ads and event posters.
Handled recruitment processing, interview scheduling, and internal transfer database management.
Completed a 4-week internship focused on Business Support Management.
Completed a 6-week internship based on Retail Banking.

strengths: Direct experience with content calendars and social media scheduling
Proficiency in Canva and MS Excel
Strong academic background with an MBA in Marketing
weaknesses: Direct marketing experience is approximately 1 year, falling short of the 2-year minimum requirement
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong technical match, possessing all the 'nice-to-have' skills and direct experience in the core tasks of the role. While total professional experience exceeds 2 years, specific marketing experience is slightly lower than requested.
